summary: Private installations can now build their updates inside your network.

fixes.title: Private installs can prepare their updates
fixes.text: On a private installation, the network SecurityInsight creates now lets the machines that prepare updates start. Nothing becomes reachable from outside.

fixes.title: Clear step when your network needs a change
fixes.text: On a network you provide that the update machines cannot start in, the install stops and names the one step your network team takes.
fixes.action: Have your network team take the step the install names.

fixes.title: Updates repair stalled update machines
fixes.text: An update repairs a private installation whose update machines do not run.
